name: King's College London
description: King's College London, founded in 1829, is a public research university in central London and a founding college of the University of London. It is a member of the Russell Group and has large health, law and social science faculties.
whyIncluded: King's College London has a student-run KCL Singapore Society that brings together Singaporean students studying at King's. Its medical and law degrees are both recognised for practice in Singapore (Singapore Medical Council and Singapore Institute of Legal Education lists).

livingCosts.summary: King's College London's own average monthly living costs for 2026-27 in London, over a 9-month undergraduate year. Excludes tuition, flights and visa costs.
livingCosts.notes: King's 'Living expenses' page (2026-27): accommodation £1,164, food £167, travel (zones 1-4) £173, personal and leisure £266, total £1,770 a month; undergraduate 9-month average £15,930 (range £11,979 to £21,078); postgraduate 12-month average £21,240. Average figures used.

programmes.name: Electronic Engineering BEng
programmes.feeBasis: The international fee King's lists on its own course page for the Electronic Engineering BEng: £40,600 a year for 2027 entry.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2027 (King's own course fees page). King's may raise fees by up to 7% a year for continuing students.
programmes.notes: Secondary source: King's undergraduate course pages and their /fees subpages load fees by JavaScript, and no official undergraduate fee table or PDF could be found (checked 2026-10-07: kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-and-funding/tuition-fees says fees are only on each course page; the UCAS entry lists the UK fee only; the returning-student fee page is an interactive form). Figure read from the Studyportals (Bachelorsportal) listing for King's College London, start date 27 September 2027, '38300 GBP / year'. Replace with the official figure when it can be read. King's states (Student Services article KA-02161) that fees for continuing international undergraduate and postgraduate taught students will not rise by more than 7% on the previous year for the same course, so fees are not fixed for the cohort: cohortLocked false. No compulsory fees besides tuition. No feeHistory rows and still secondary: on 2026-10-13 the King's course /fees pages (e.g. computer-science-bsc, physics-bsc) still returned no figures without JavaScript, and no official King's fee schedule or year-dated figure for 2024, 2025 or 2026 entry was found. 2024-2026 rows still unfilled (2026-10-13, unofficial search): r.jina.ai could not render kcl.ac.uk pages; Hotcourses, Complete University Guide, Yocket, TopUniversities and Collegedunia give only undated or 2027-start fees, and blog figures (e.g. iSchoolConnect's MBBS fee) were contradictory, so none was used. Round 3 (2026-10-13): King's study-abroad '2025-26 fees for reference' page gives only visiting-student fees; whatdotheyknow.com FOI replies cannot be fetched (robots); no year-dated full-degree figure found. Round 4 (2026-10-13): the older kcl.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/taught-courses/.../fees URLs and Unienrol listings show only 2026/27 or undated figures; still unfilled. Round 5 (2026-10-13): King's course pages are built from a CMS record whose JSON is embedded in the page HTML (window.REDUX_DATA, readable with curl). The /fees page's own record gives the 2027/28 international fee £40,600 (visible text: 'The International tuition fee for the 2027-2028 academic year is £40,600 per year'), which differs from the Studyportals figure in `fees` (corrected later in this note). The linked course record still carries the previous fee import, internationalFee '35,800', whose study-abroad text in the same record refers to 2025/26; this is dated to 2025 entry because King's 2026/27 returning-student fee lookup (CMS type courseFees2026, course UBSH3CSEEB, year 2, overseas) gives £38,300 (35,800 plus 7% is 38,306, capped at what appears to be the 2026 new-entrant fee), under King's rule of at most 7% a year for continuing students. Added 2025 row £35,800 (official). No 2024 or 2026 entry figure found: the CMS keeps no older versions, and the 2025/26 returning-fee table (courseFees2025) gives only continuing-student rates, which were not used. Round 5 (2026-10-13): current fee corrected to the official figure. The King's course fees page, rendered with JavaScript, reads 'The International tuition fee for the 2027-2028 academic year is £40,600 per year'; the Studyportals figure previously used (£38,300) was lower and appears to be the 2026 entry fee, so it was replaced. sourceType is now official. Round 6 (2026-10-13): rechecked King's CMS (Contensis delivery API): the returning-student tables courseFees2025/courseFees2026 hold only years 2 and 3 (no year-1 new-entrant rate), there is no courseFees2024 table, and no fee schedule PDF or asset for 2024/25 or 2026/27 entry exists in the CMS asset store; WebSearch found only undated aggregator figures. 2024 and 2026 rows still unfilled (not back-calculated from continuing-student rates). Round 7 (2026-10-13, Common Crawl captures of official pages): Common Crawl capture of King's course page; fee is the page's own course record (window.REDUX_DATA routing.entry internationalFee, unlabelled) and the same page gives 'Start date: September 2024'. Common Crawl capture of King's /fees subpage; figure from the page's own '<course> - Fees' record (the parent course record on the same page still carries the stale 2025 figure); page shows 'Start date: September 2026'.
